name: rest-hang-risks
method: Counted every fetch() / wp.apiFetch() call in src/ and assets/js/. Looked for AbortController instantiation, signal: passing, or surrounding setTimeout-based race-with-abort patterns. A call counts as 'hang risk' if a slow REST/network response would freeze the UI without recovery (modal stays open, button stays disabled, infinite spinner).

added_in_1_2_0.purpose: POST /media/{id}/share — record share event when user clicks Share in lightbox
added_in_1_2_0.ux_impact: Low — user has already triggered navigator.share or clipboard copy; this is an analytics-style fire-and-forget. Hang only delays the success toast. .catch() swallow present, no recovery needed.

added_in_1_2_0.purpose: POST /media/{id}/download — record download event when user clicks Download in lightbox
added_in_1_2_0.ux_impact: Low-medium — fires before the actual download navigation. If REST hangs, the browser tab stays on the lightbox. A 30s server-side timeout would mask it. Worth adding AbortController with 5s timeout in 1.2.1; not a 1.2.0 ship blocker.

added_in_1_2_0.purpose: PUT /media/{id} — Edit-modal save (new in 1.2.0; previously edit was admin-only)
added_in_1_2_0.ux_impact: Medium — modal stays open with disabled Save button. No spinner abort path. If REST 504s or network drops mid-save, user has no escape except page reload (loses modal state). Recommend 10s AbortController + 'Save failed, try again' toast in 1.2.1.

Medium — already debounced 250ms via setTimeout, but no abort of in-flight requests when the user keeps typing. Race: slow first request can overwrite a fast second request's results. Recommend AbortController.abort() in the debounce timer reset path; user-visible bug in slow networks (autocomplete shows stale results for old query).

pre_existing_hang_risks.purpose: POST /albums — create album from upload modal
GET /privacy_groups (BP) — load groups for privacy dropdown

result.summary: Zero AbortController + zero fetch signal + zero setTimeout-abort patterns across 23 fetch calls. Systemic issue (predates 1.2.0). Highest-impact 1.2.0 additions: Edit-modal save (line 485) and search autocomplete (line 332).

src/blocks/dashboard-view/view.js, src/blocks/explore-view/view.js, src/blocks/media-social/view.js, src/blocks/media-grid/view.js, src/blocks/explore-feed/view.js — all use the same fetch() pattern with no abort. Total +31 fetch sites, 0 abort sites. Same systemic pattern. No 1.2.0 regressions in these files.
Legacy non-Interactivity scripts. Same pattern. Highest-impact: messaging.js (poll-style transport already has internal recovery via interval reset, so hang is self-healing within ~5s).

notes: Systemic — no fetch in the entire JS surface uses AbortController or signal: option. The 4 new 1.2.0 fetches inherit this pattern. None are individually a 1.2.0 ship blocker. Recommend a 1.2.1 'fetch hardening' pass that adds an apiFetchWithAbort() helper in src/shared/ and migrates the 54 call sites. Specifically the search autocomplete (line 332) is a real correctness bug — slow requests can overwrite fast ones, showing stale results.
